answer: Farming becomes an onyx bet on surviving 81 epochs of grading, and every glacier settlement recomputes the signal schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 81 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 34 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
